workspace.name: TASK-BAL-074 Evidence・装備込みPhysical Basic Attack基準

project_context.purpose: TASK-BAL-074 Physical Skill Budget前段。Human指定の物理5職LoadoutとCurrent B780 Equipment Generator出力を使用し、装備込みFormal Basic Attack DPT基準をHuman実機で固定する。
project_context.summary: 250/250条件、7,500/7,500 trials完走、error 0、Formal binding一致、formal_only 250/250、legacy fallback 0。剣士=大剣、騎士=片手剣+盾、盗賊=短剣1本、狩人=弓、冒険家=片手剣。騎士はFormal weapon_shield profileで盾をStrikeから除外していることを50/50条件で確認。

current_focus.theme: Physical Equipped Basic Attack Baseline Evidence
current_focus.goal: 物理Skill Budgetの比較基準に使える装備込みBasic AttackのHuman実機Evidenceを保持する。

evidence_manifest.purpose: Physical Equipped Basic Attack Human real-device baseline
evidence_manifest.scope: Physical only / 5 jobs / Lv1-50 / Current generated equipment

equipment_numeric_authority.source: Current GKS-B780 Equipment Generator output embedded in result input

measurement_contract.note: This is an equipped Basic Attack throughput baseline against a neutral measurement fixture, not a Player-vs-Monster outcome baseline.

formal_validation.analytic_reference_note: Measured DPT includes 30-trial 5% weapon critical sampling. Analytic reference uses Current Formal per-hit floor and +50% critical damage.
formal_validation.important_knight_note: Actor total equipment contribution contains sword+shield totals, but Current Formal weapon_shield attack profile subtracts both hand totals then adds only weapon1 for the Basic Attack strike. Shield contributes zero attack strike.
